newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yamaichi president resigns as bond body chairman.
newsitem.headline: Yamaichi president resigns as bond body chairman.

text.p: Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd president Atsuo Miki has resigned as chairman of the Bond Underwriters' Association of Japan due to his company's alleged involvement in a high-profile payoff scandal, the association said on Tuesday.
He resigned on August 1, an association spokesman said.
Miki said he believed that it was not appropriate to remain as chairman after Yamaichi's offices were raided by authorities, the association said.
On July 30, prosecutors and officials of the Securities and Exchange and Surveillance Commission raided the offices of Yamaichi looking for evidence of an alleged payoff to a "sokaiya" racketeer.
On Friday, Yamaichi chairman Tsugio Yukihira offered his resignation as head of the Japan Securities Dealers' Association.
